Compassion was founded on: reaching young people with the transformative power of God's Word, grounded in Scripture and responsive to the realities they face. Many of the young people we serve navigate complex identities — bridging their heritage with life in America, processing trauma, and seeking purpose.</p>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 1.1rem;">This is a ministry of teaching and discipleship, led by our founder, Evangelist Gai Bol Luom. It is not a program with a building or a budget line — it is patient, personal work: opening the Bible with young people, walking alongside them, and preparing believers who are ready to publicly declare their faith through baptism.</p>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0;">Gatherings for worship, teaching, and fellowship bring young people together for spiritual refreshment — and the one-on-one work continues between them.</p>
